name: 0 · The Fool
title: The Fool (Le Mat)
imagery: A wanderer in a patched, bell-trimmed costume strides along with a bundle tied to a stick over his shoulder and a long staff in his other hand. A small animal tugs at his leg from behind, yet he keeps walking, eyes on the road ahead. In the Marseille deck he carries no number at all, so he belongs everywhere and nowhere.
meaning: Le Mat is pure movement: the soul that refuses to be pinned down. He travels light, follows instinct, and trusts the road to teach him what he needs. This card invites you to step outside the expected, to act from enthusiasm rather than fear, and to let life surprise you. It can also ask whether you are wandering with purpose or simply avoiding a decision. Carry only what you truly need, and keep going.
numerology: Unnumbered in the Marseille deck, the Fool stands outside the sequence. He is the zero before the count and the energy that moves through every card.
affirmation: I walk my own road with an open heart.

ctx.past: You have already taken a leap that others called foolish, and it shaped you. That restless, free part of you broke you out of a box, even if the road was rough. Remember how alive you felt.
ctx.present: Right now you are on the move, or longing to be. The old structures no longer hold you, and instinct is calling louder than reason. Walk, but notice what is tugging at your heels.
ctx.future: A journey or a fresh, unplanned chapter is coming. Expect to leave something familiar behind and to travel lighter than before. The road will open as you walk it.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is drifting without direction or ignoring a real warning. That little animal at your heels may be trying to tell you something. Freedom without awareness can turn into running away.
ctx.advice: Pack light and go. Trust your instinct over other people's expectations, and let curiosity lead. You do not need the whole map to take the next step.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a free spirit, unwilling to be defined by roles or rules. That independence is a gift. Make sure it is chosen, not a way of never landing anywhere.
ctx.others: Others may see you as unpredictable, eccentric, or delightfully unbothered. Someone around you may also be the wanderer here, hard to hold down and impossible to tame.
ctx.hopes: You hope for freedom and fear being trapped, or perhaps you fear having no ground beneath you at all. Both feelings are honest. The road can hold both.
ctx.love: Love here is light, spontaneous and unconventional. It asks for space and honesty about what each of you wants. A new romance may begin unexpectedly, on the road.
ctx.work: An unconventional path, freelance life or a sudden change of direction is favored. Follow the work that makes you feel alive, but keep a little bundle of savings on your stick.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you that the sacred includes the holy fool. Laughter, wandering and not-knowing are spiritual paths too. Walk in trust.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to know exactly where you are going. Release roles that no longer fit, and the weight of carrying everything you once thought you needed.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here is a fear of commitment dressed up as freedom. Ask whether you keep moving so that nothing can catch up with you, including your own feelings.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter is a deep need for freedom and authenticity. Everything else grows from your refusal to live a life that feels like a costume.
ctx.gift: Your gift is fearless openness. You can begin again anywhere, with almost nothing, and still find joy along the way.

name: I · The Magician
title: I · The Magician (Le Bateleur)
imagery: A young street performer in a wide hat stands behind a small table spread with cups, coins, a knife, dice and a bag. He holds a slender wand in one hand and a small coin or ball in the other, his feet planted wide on ground sprouting small plants. The table shows only three legs, hinting that something remains unseen.
meaning: Le Bateleur is the beginner with every tool already on the table. He is clever, quick and playful, a juggler who can turn ordinary objects into wonder. This card says you have what you need to start: talent, ideas and the nerve to try. It asks you to focus, choose your tools wisely and act with intention. Just keep an honest eye on the line between skill and trickery.
numerology: One is the first step, the single point where potential becomes action. The Bateleur opens the numbered series of the Major Arcana.
affirmation: I have what I need to begin, and I use it wisely.

ctx.past: You once started something with little more than nerve and a few tools, and it worked. That early spark of initiative still powers you. Your resourcefulness is proven.
ctx.present: Everything is on the table right now. You have options, skills and energy, and the moment favors a confident first move. Pick up your wand and start.
ctx.future: A new project, role or opportunity is coming that will showcase your abilities. Expect to be noticed for your skill and quick thinking. Be ready to perform.
ctx.challenge: Too many tools and too little focus can scatter your power. Watch, too, for sleight of hand, yours or someone else's. Cleverness without honesty backfires.
ctx.advice: Choose one thing and do it with full intention. Gather your tools, practice your craft, and begin before you feel completely ready.
ctx.self: You see yourself as capable and inventive, someone who can make something from nothing. Trust that, and keep learning so your talent becomes mastery.
ctx.others: Others see you as clever and charming, perhaps a bit of a performer. Someone near you may be a persuasive talker; enjoy the show but check the details.
ctx.hopes: You hope your skills will finally be recognized, and you may fear being exposed as a beginner. Every master was once a juggler at a street table.
ctx.love: Attraction sparkles with wit and flirtation. A new connection may begin through conversation. Make sure the charm is backed by sincerity on both sides.
ctx.work: A great card for launching a business, pitching an idea or learning a trade. Use your communication skills, and keep your tools organized.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you that magic is focused will. What you hold in mind and hand, you can bring into being. Begin your working with clear intention.
ctx.release: Release the belief that you need more before you can start. Let go of scattered efforts and any temptation to cut corners or trick your way through.
ctx.shadow: A hidden fear of being a fraud may drive you to perform rather than practice. The unseen fourth leg of the table asks what you have not yet admitted.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is your own initiative. Things began with a spark of will, and they will move only when you act on it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is adaptability and the ability to see possibility in ordinary things. You can turn whatever is at hand into a tool.

name: II · The High Priestess
title: II · The Popess (La Papesse)
imagery: A woman wearing a tall papal crown sits enthroned with a large open book on her lap, a veil or curtain draped behind her. Her robes are layered in blue and red, and her gaze is steady and inward. She is the keeper of a knowledge that is studied slowly and revealed only in its time.
meaning: La Papesse holds wisdom that grows in stillness. She studies, waits and listens, and she does not rush to speak. This card asks you to slow down, gather knowledge and trust what your quiet inner voice already knows. Something is still gestating, behind the veil, and it will not be hurried. Read, reflect and keep your counsel until the moment is ripe.
numerology: Two is receptivity, the pause after the first action. Where the Bateleur acts, the Popess absorbs and holds.
affirmation: I trust the wisdom that grows in my silence.

ctx.past: A period of study, solitude or quiet waiting prepared you for now. What you learned when no one was watching is still serving you.
ctx.present: This is a time to observe rather than act. Something is not yet fully revealed. Listen, read the signs and keep your plans close.
ctx.future: Knowledge will come to you, perhaps through a teacher, a book or a dream. A secret may be revealed in time. Patience will be rewarded.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is too much waiting, or knowledge kept locked away when it should be shared. Coldness or secrecy can isolate you.
ctx.advice: Study the matter. Keep a journal, meditate and let your intuition speak before you decide. Say less than you know for now.
ctx.self: You see yourself as private, thoughtful and wise beyond your years. Your depth is real; let the right people in.
ctx.others: Someone around you holds information they are not sharing. Others may see you as mysterious or hard to read.
ctx.hopes: You hope for understanding and fear what may be hidden. The veil lifts slowly; you will know when you are ready to know.
ctx.love: Love here is quiet and deep, or still unspoken. There may be feelings not yet revealed. Give the bond time and respect its mystery.
ctx.work: Research, study, writing, counseling and behind-the-scenes work are favored. Do your homework before any big move.
ctx.spirit: Your guides speak through dreams, symbols and silence. Keep a dream journal and sit with sacred texts that call to you.
ctx.release: Release the urge to have every answer now. Let go of noise, gossip and the need to explain yourself to everyone.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here is knowledge you already have but do not want to admit. Your intuition has spoken; you may be pretending not to hear.
ctx.foundation: Beneath this situation lies something still developing in secret. Its roots are in learning, intuition and patience.
ctx.gift: Your gift is deep inner knowing. When you are quiet, you can sense what others miss.

name: III · The Empress
title: III · The Empress (L'Impératrice)
imagery: A crowned empress sits facing us on her throne, the back of which rises behind her like a pair of wings. She holds a scepter topped with an orb and cross and cradles a shield bearing an eagle. Her pose is open and frontal, full of calm authority and fruitful energy.
meaning: L'Impératrice is creative power in full bloom: ideas becoming real, seeds becoming harvest. She is confident, expressive and generous, ruling through warmth and imagination rather than force. This card promises growth when you nurture what you love. Make, grow, plant, create. Let yourself enjoy beauty and abundance without apology.
numerology: Three is creation, the child of one and two. Here potential and patience combine to produce something new.
affirmation: What I nurture grows and flourishes.

ctx.past: A time of creativity, growth or nurturing laid the groundwork for now. Something you cared for in the past is still bearing fruit.
ctx.present: Creative energy is flowing. This is a fertile moment for projects, relationships and self-expression. Say yes to what wants to grow.
ctx.future: Abundance and creative success are on the way. A project, a home or a relationship will blossom. You may also step into a nurturing role.
ctx.challenge: Overindulgence or smothering can block growth. Watch for creative energy spent on pleasing others rather than expressing yourself.
ctx.advice: Create something. Tend your garden, literal or metaphorical, and treat yourself with the same care you give others.
ctx.self: You see yourself as creative and nurturing, or you are learning to. Own your beauty and your ability to make things grow.
ctx.others: A warm, generous person, often a woman or a mother figure, influences this matter. Others see you as caring and capable.
ctx.hopes: You hope for abundance and creative fulfillment, and may fear that your gifts will go unused. They will not if you begin.
ctx.love: Love is affectionate, sensual and growing. A relationship may deepen, or a family may expand. Romance thrives with care.
ctx.work: Creative fields, design, growing, caregiving and anything you build with love are favored. Expect steady, fruitful progress.
ctx.spirit: The Great Mother is near. Honor the earth, your body and the cycles of growth. Your creativity is sacred.
ctx.release: Release scarcity thinking and the habit of giving until you are empty. Let go of creativity held back by perfectionism.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear that you are only valued for what you give. Your worth is not your output.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter is creative life force. Something here was born from love and wants to keep growing.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to make things flourish. People, plants and ideas thrive in your care.

name: IV · The Emperor
title: IIII · The Emperor (L'Empereur)
imagery: An older emperor sits in profile on his seat, one leg crossed over the other, holding a scepter. A shield with an eagle rests near his feet, and a heavy chain hangs at his neck. His crossed legs echo the shape of the number four, a figure of solid, earthly order.
meaning: L'Empereur builds and protects. He represents structure, discipline and the power to make things last in the material world. This card asks you to take charge, set boundaries and create a stable foundation. Leadership here means responsibility, not domination. Plan, organize and stand firm in what you have built.
numerology: Four, written IIII on this deck, is the square and the foundation. It brings stability, walls and rules that hold.
affirmation: I build a strong foundation and stand by it.

ctx.past: Structure or a strong authority figure shaped your past. Discipline you learned then is part of your backbone now.
ctx.present: This situation calls for order and leadership. Make a plan, set the rules and take responsibility for the outcome.
ctx.future: Stability is coming. Expect a promotion, a secure home or a structure that finally holds. You may take on a leadership role.
ctx.challenge: Rigidity and control are the risk. Rules that once protected you may now be a cage. Authority without warmth breeds resistance.
ctx.advice: Get organized. Set clear boundaries, create routines and act with calm authority. Protect what matters.
ctx.self: You see yourself as dependable and in charge. Strength is yours; let it include flexibility and kindness.
ctx.others: A boss, father figure or institution has influence here. Others see you as solid, maybe stern.
ctx.hopes: You hope for security and fear losing control. True security comes from foundations, not from controlling everything.
ctx.love: Love here is loyal, protective and committed. It may need more tenderness. A stable partnership is possible.
ctx.work: Management, business, law and planning are favored. Build systems and take on responsibility.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to bring sacred order to daily life. Ritual, routine and grounded practice support your spirit.
ctx.release: Release the need to control every detail and any outdated rules you inherited. Let go of harsh self-discipline.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of chaos that makes you cling to control. Vulnerability is not weakness.
ctx.foundation: The foundation is structure and authority. How power is held, by you or others, underlies this matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to create safety and order. People feel secure when you are in charge.

name: V · The Hierophant
title: V · The Pope (Le Pape)
imagery: The Pope sits between two columns wearing a triple crown and holding a triple cross. His gloved hand is raised in blessing, and two smaller tonsured figures kneel before him, seen from behind. He is the bridge between heaven and the people who come to him for guidance.
meaning: Le Pape is the teacher who passes wisdom on. Where the Popess studies in silence, the Pope speaks and blesses. This card points to mentors, traditions, institutions and the comfort of shared belief. It asks you to seek good counsel or to become a teacher yourself. Honor what tradition offers while staying true to your own conscience.
numerology: Five is the bridge between worlds, the center point of the hand. The Pope connects the divine to the human.
affirmation: I receive wisdom with gratitude and share it generously.

ctx.past: A teacher, tradition or faith community shaped you. Lessons from that time are still your compass.
ctx.present: Guidance is available now. Seek a mentor, an expert or an established path. Communication and learning are central.
ctx.future: You will find a teacher or become one. A commitment, ceremony or formal recognition may be coming.
ctx.challenge: Blind obedience or rigid dogma is the obstacle. Do not hand your conscience to any authority.
ctx.advice: Ask for guidance, study within a tradition and share what you know. Speak with kindness and authority.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a guide or a seeker of guidance. You value wisdom and the bonds of community.
ctx.others: A mentor, counselor or institution influences this. Others may look to you for advice.
ctx.hopes: You hope for belonging and clear guidance, and fear conformity or judgment. Find a tradition that honors who you are.
ctx.love: Love seeks commitment and shared values. A formal step, like a marriage or blessing, may be in the cards.
ctx.work: Teaching, counseling, ministry and established organizations are favored. Follow proven methods.
ctx.spirit: Your guides bless you. A spiritual teacher or practice can deepen your path now.
ctx.release: Release beliefs you accepted only because you were told to. Keep what is true; let the rest go.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a longing for approval from an authority that cannot give it. Your own blessing counts.
ctx.foundation: Shared beliefs and traditions underlie this matter. What you were taught shapes how you see it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to teach, counsel and bless. Your words can heal and guide.

name: VI · The Lovers
title: VI · The Lover (L'Amoureux)
imagery: A young man stands between two women, one older and crowned, the other younger and garlanded, each seeming to claim his attention. Above them, a winged Cupid within a blazing sun aims his arrow downward. The scene is less a wedding than a crossroads of the heart.
meaning: L'Amoureux is about choice. The heart is pulled in different directions: duty or desire, old ties or new love, what others want or what you want. Cupid's arrow suggests that something greater than reason will decide. This card asks you to choose from your deepest values and to let love, not fear, guide you. Relationships are central, and so is honesty.
numerology: Six is harmony and exchange between people. It holds the tension of choosing and the beauty of union.
affirmation: I choose with my heart and my values aligned.

ctx.past: A key choice of the heart shaped your path. A love, or a decision between two directions, still echoes.
ctx.present: You are at a crossroads. Two options, two people or two parts of yourself pull at you. Listen to your heart.
ctx.future: An important choice or meaningful relationship is coming. Cupid's arrow may strike when you least expect it.
ctx.challenge: Indecision or divided loyalty is the problem. Trying to please everyone means no one, including you, is happy.
ctx.advice: Choose. Let your values decide, not guilt or outside pressure. Commit fully to what you pick.
ctx.self: You see yourself as torn, or as a person who loves deeply. Know what you truly value.
ctx.others: Others may be pulling you toward their preferences. A partner or a family member has a stake in your choice.
ctx.hopes: You hope for true love and fear choosing wrong. No choice made from the heart is truly wrong.
ctx.love: A strong card for romance and partnership. It may also mark a choice between relationships or a new attraction.
ctx.work: A decision between paths or partners at work. Choose the work you love, and partnerships aligned with your values.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you that love is a spiritual force. Choose the path that opens your heart.
ctx.release: Release the need for everyone's approval. Let go of a relationship or path that no longer matches who you are.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a choice you are avoiding, or a desire you have not admitted. Name it.
ctx.foundation: At the root is a matter of the heart and of values. What you love underlies everything here.
ctx.gift: Your gift is a heart capable of deep connection and honest choice.

name: VII · The Chariot
title: VII · The Chariot (Le Chariot)
imagery: A crowned figure in armor rides a square chariot beneath a canopy, holding a scepter. Small faces decorate his shoulders, and two horses pull the chariot, seemingly in different directions. He holds no reins, steering by will alone.
meaning: Le Chariot is forward motion powered by confidence. Success comes from holding opposing forces together and moving in one direction. This card speaks of victory, travel, ambition and self-mastery. It asks you to take the driver's seat and commit to your course. Your will is the reins.
numerology: Seven is effort and movement toward a goal. It marks a victory won through determination.
affirmation: I move forward with focus and confidence.

ctx.past: A past victory or bold move set things in motion. You proved you could direct your life.
ctx.present: Momentum is with you. Commit to your goal and drive forward with confidence.
ctx.future: Success, travel or advancement is coming. Expect to overcome obstacles through sheer determination.
ctx.challenge: Forces pull in different directions. Without focus, the horses go nowhere. Ego can also take the wheel.
ctx.advice: Take control. Decide where you are going and hold steady. Discipline will carry you through.
ctx.self: You see yourself as driven and capable of winning. Make sure the victory is one you truly want.
ctx.others: Others see you as ambitious and unstoppable. A determined person may be driving this situation.
ctx.hopes: You hope for success and fear losing control. Control comes from within, not from the road.
ctx.love: Love moves forward. A relationship may progress quickly, or require you to balance two needs.
ctx.work: Advancement, competition and new ventures are favored. Push forward with confidence.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to master yourself. Your spirit grows as you unite your will with your purpose.
ctx.release: Release scattered goals and the habit of being pulled by every distraction.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be aggression or a need to win that masks insecurity.
ctx.foundation: Determination underlies this matter. It started with someone deciding to move.
ctx.gift: Your gift is willpower. You can unite conflicting forces and drive toward your goal.

name: VIII · Strength
title: XI · Strength (La Force)
imagery: A woman in a wide, curving hat, the same shape as the Bateleur's, calmly holds open the jaws of a lion with her bare hands. Her face is serene and her touch unhurried. In the Marseille deck she is number XI, the start of the second half of the Major Arcana.
meaning: La Force is the power to work with your instincts rather than fight them. Her strength is calm, patient and kind, which is why the lion does not resist. This card says you can face fear, anger or desire with steady confidence. Lead with gentleness and trust. Real strength rarely needs to roar.
numerology: Eleven begins a new cycle of the Major Arcana. It marks inner strength as the first step toward deeper transformation.
affirmation: My strength is calm, patient and kind.

ctx.past: You have already tamed a fear or a fierce emotion through patience. That quiet victory is part of your foundation.
ctx.present: The situation calls for calm courage. Meet strong feelings, yours or someone else's, with steady kindness.
ctx.future: Confidence and inner strength are growing. You will handle what once scared you with grace.
ctx.challenge: Self-doubt, or using force where gentleness would work, is the obstacle. The lion responds to calm, not fear.
ctx.advice: Be patient with yourself and others. Breathe, soften and keep going. Gentle persistence wins.
ctx.self: You see yourself as strong, or you are discovering your strength. Trust your quiet power.
ctx.others: Others see you as steady and brave. Someone around you may need your calm presence.
ctx.hopes: You hope to master your fears and fear losing control. You can hold both with gentleness.
ctx.love: Love grows through patience and trust. Passion is present; let tenderness guide it.
ctx.work: Steady effort and calm leadership win. Handle difficult people with patience and confidence.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you that your instincts are sacred. Befriend your inner animal.
ctx.release: Release self-criticism and the urge to dominate or suppress your feelings.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be anger or desire you have been afraid to acknowledge. It wants understanding.
ctx.foundation: Inner strength underlies this matter. Your capacity to stay calm is the key.
ctx.gift: Your gift is gentle courage. You can soothe what others fear.

name: IX · The Hermit
title: VIIII · The Hermit (L'Hermite)
imagery: An old man in a heavy hooded cloak walks slowly with a staff, holding up a lantern that is partly hidden by the folds of his cloak. He seems to be searching, peering ahead into the dark. His light is shielded, shared only with those who seek it.
meaning: L'Hermite is the seeker who withdraws to find truth. He moves slowly and carefully, guided by the small light of experience. This card asks you to step back, reflect and look within. Answers will come through patience and solitude, not noise. You may also be called to share your hard-won wisdom with someone who is searching.
numerology: Nine, written VIIII here, is completion and wisdom. It marks the end of a long road and the knowledge gained along the way.
affirmation: I find my answers in quiet reflection.

ctx.past: A period of solitude or soul-searching taught you much. That inner work still guides you.
ctx.present: Now is a time for reflection. Step back from the crowd and listen to your inner voice.
ctx.future: A time of retreat, study or spiritual seeking is coming. A wise mentor may appear.
ctx.challenge: Isolation or overthinking can block you. Solitude should restore you, not wall you off.
ctx.advice: Withdraw for a while. Meditate, walk and think deeply before you decide.
ctx.self: You see yourself as an old soul or a seeker. Your wisdom grows in quiet.
ctx.others: A wise elder or teacher may help. Others may see you as distant or introspective.
ctx.hopes: You hope for clarity and fear loneliness. Solitude can be the doorway to clarity.
ctx.love: Love may need space or patience. A quiet, deep connection or a period of being single is indicated.
ctx.work: Research, specialized expertise and independent work are favored. Take time to plan.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to go inward. Your own lantern is enough light for the next step.
ctx.release: Release the need for constant company and outside opinions.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of others that looks like independence.
ctx.foundation: A search for meaning underlies this matter. Something deeper is asking to be understood.
ctx.gift: Your gift is wisdom born of experience. Your light can guide others.

name: X · Wheel of Fortune
title: X · The Wheel of Fortune (La Roue de Fortune)
imagery: A wooden wheel with a crank handle turns on its axle. One animal-like creature climbs up one side while another tumbles down the other, and a crowned sphinx with a sword sits on a platform at the top. No hand is shown on the crank, as if fate turns it by itself.
meaning: La Roue de Fortune shows that life moves in cycles. What rises will fall and what falls will rise again. This card marks a turning point, a change of luck or a new chapter set in motion. It asks you to adapt and ride the wheel rather than resist it. Your choices matter, but so does timing. Notice where you are on the wheel.
numerology: Ten completes one cycle and begins another. It is the end of one turn of the wheel and the start of the next.
affirmation: I flow with change and trust the turning wheel.

ctx.past: A turning point in your past changed everything. Fortune shifted, and you are still riding that change.
ctx.present: Things are changing quickly. Luck may be turning in your favor. Stay alert and adaptable.
ctx.future: A major shift is coming. New opportunities will appear as one cycle ends and another begins.
ctx.challenge: Resisting change or relying only on luck is the obstacle. You cannot stop the wheel, but you can steer your response.
ctx.advice: Embrace the change. Seize opportunities and prepare for both ups and downs.
ctx.self: You see yourself as subject to fate, or as lucky. Remember you can act within the cycle.
ctx.others: Outside events or people you cannot control are influencing this. Watch the larger pattern.
ctx.hopes: You hope for good fortune and fear a downturn. Every low point is also a new beginning.
ctx.love: A relationship may be at a turning point. Fate may bring someone new or change the course of a bond.
ctx.work: Career shifts, unexpected opportunities and changing markets. Be flexible and ready.
ctx.spirit: Your guides remind you of the great cycles of life. Everything turns, and so do you.
ctx.release: Release the fantasy that things will stay the same forever.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a feeling of powerlessness. You have more choice than you think.
ctx.foundation: Cycles and timing underlie this matter. It is part of a larger turning.
ctx.gift: Your gift is adaptability. You can ride any turn of fortune.
